description: Chrome-side sync engine for Zen Twilight: capture, digest diff and apply of spaces, essentials, pinned and open tabs, folders, splits, containers and keyboard shortcuts.

functions.name: start
functions.description: Starts the engine once the session is restored; resolves with the environment.

functions.name: getEnvironment
functions.description: Compatibility probe, platform, conflicting-engine state, provisioning prefs and options.

functions.name: setOptions
functions.description: Sets { normalTabs, shortcuts, keyMapping }. Resolves { options, keyMappingChanged }.

functions.name: setSpacesEnginePref
functions.description: Sets services.sync.engine.spaces (Zen's native Firefox Sync Spaces engine).

functions.name: getFullProjection
functions.description: Every current record as [{id, kind, data}].

functions.name: applyRecords
functions.description: Applies { records, deleted, reconcile, overrideGuard }. Resolves { failed, skipped, guard }.

functions.name: reconnectMerge
functions.description: Applies the server's full record set preserving offline work: { records, overrideGuard }.

functions.name: markUploaded
functions.description: Advances the baseline from an acknowledged payload: { records, deleted }.

events.name: onLocalChanges
events.description: A capture found local changes: { changed: [{id, kind, data}], deleted: [ids] }.
